svg.aria-label: Beyond the core, the cache hierarchy and memory
svg.text: Beyond the core, the cache hierarchy and memory
The P-cluster shares an L2 and an AMX unit. The SLC sits on the memory side of coherence and fills from L2 victims. Latencies are what one core measures.
4 Firestorm cores, 3.2 GHz max, one clock domain
share the fabric and the memory side
12 MiB, 12 ways, 128 B lines in two halves
8192 sets, physical index, two bits hashed
17 clk hit; 85 GB/s load, 100 GB/s store per core
inclusive of the L1Ds; spares L1 resident lines
four 3 MiB cachelets; a core sees 7.5 MiB
per core LRU; three separately powered way groups
2 instr per clk in, via the SQ
L1 to L2: 32 B per clk each way, per core
L2 TLB and page walkers may sit beside it ~
E cores may use this L2 while P cores sleep ~
4 cores, own L2, own clock domain
per cluster DVFS; ramp from idle 40 to 100 ms
power estimator throttles vector and AMX issue
E-cluster and GPU also request through the fabric
coherence point with duplicate L2 tags, before the SLC
separate PIO network for device traffic
memory side, exclusive of the CPU caches
hashed set index from PA bit 7 up
about 90 clk; replacement pseudo random, disputed
68 GB/s peak, 64 GB/s from one core
reads and writes share one path
